purpose: R9 closure: a genuine 95% CL statement on A_dip from the exact committed primary null, distinct from the Eq. 1 injection-recovery detection-power threshold A_95^obs.
statement: The 95th percentile of the exact committed 10,000-draw primary null is 0.669%: under this null, A_dip realizations at or above 0.669% occur in <5% of draws. The observed A_dip=0.467% lies below this threshold, so it is null-consistent at 95% CL directly from the null distribution -- a genuine confidence-level statement, distinct from and complementary to Eq. 1's A_95^obs=0.98%, which is an injection-recovery detection-power threshold (the amplitude at which an INJECTED signal would be recovered 95% of the time), not a CL bound on the observed value.
